name: Minecraft: Vanilla
description: The official Mojang Java Edition server — unmodified gameplay, no plugin support.

install.label: Download the Mojang server jar
install.run:
MANIFEST=https://launchermeta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json
URL=$(curl -sf "$MANIFEST" | node -e 'let d="";const want=process.argv[1];process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c).on("end",()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);const id=(!want||want==="latest")?j.latest.release:want;const v=j.versions.find(v=>v.id===id);if(!v){console.error("Unknown Minecraft version: "+id);process.exit(1);}console.log(v.url);})' "{{MC_VERSION}}")
[ -n "$URL" ] || gp_die "Could not resolve that Minecraft version"
JAR=$(curl -sf "$URL" | node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c).on("end",()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);if(!j.downloads.server){console.error("That version has no dedicated server download");process.exit(1);}console.log(j.downloads.server.url);})')
[ -n "$JAR" ] || gp_die "No server download for that version"
gp_fetch "$JAR" server.jar

install.content:
# Accepted through GamePanel on install
eula=true
